dialog_type.description: The type of dialog box to display (yesno, msgbox, inputbox, passwordbox, textbox, menu, checklist, radiolist, infobox, gauge).

title.description: Title string displayed at the top of the dialog box.

backtitle.description: Backtitle string displayed on the backdrop at the top of the screen.

text.description: The main text content of the dialog box.

height.description: Height of the dialog box in rows.

width.description: Width of the dialog box in columns.

menu_height.description: Height of the menu/list portion for menu, checklist, and radiobox types.

list_height.description: Height of the list portion for checklist and radiolist types.

init_text.description: Initial text for inputbox or passwordbox widgets.

text_file.description: Path to the text file for the textbox widget.

initial_percent.description: Initial percentage for the gauge widget.

menu_items.description: List of menu items for menu type. Each item is a flat map with 'tag' and 'description'. See items schema below.

menu_items_items.description: Internal placeholder to define the flat structure for list items. 'tag' is the unique identifier, 'description' is the display text.

checklist_items.description: List of checklist items. Each item is a flat map with 'tag', 'description', and 'status' (on/off). See items schema below.

checklist_items_items.description: Internal placeholder to define the flat structure for list items. 'status' must be 'on' or 'off'.

radiolist_items.description: List of radiolist items. Each item is a flat map with 'tag', 'description', and 'status' (on/off). See items schema below.

radiolist_items_items.description: Internal placeholder to define the flat structure for list items. 'status' must be 'on' or 'off'.

default_item.description: Set the default selected item in a menu box.

defaultno.description: Open the dialog with the cursor over the No button.

fullbuttons.description: Use full buttons instead of compact buttons.

noitem.description: Display tags only, not item strings in menu/checklist/radiolist.

separate_output.description: Output checklist results one line at a time without quoting.

output_fd.description: File descriptor to direct output to.

scrolltext.description: Force display of a vertical scrollbar.

topleft.description: Put the window in the top-left corner.
